3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: Their voices were getting louder and louder.

4.speaker: Iosef Lancea
4.text: “How dare the police meddle in the affairs of the Gendarmerie?”

5.speaker: Lileas Graf
5.text: “It was *your* men who started this ridiculousness and meddled with an ongoing police investigation.”

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: I opened the doors to the meeting room. The two ministers did not even realise.

7.speaker: Iosef Lancea
7.text: “Rural security is my jurisdiction and your men were way outside of Vesord.”

8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: I had seen the reports of a recent issue that rose between the Sordish Police Forces and the Gendarmerie units at the city.

11.speaker: Player
11.text: “Don't worry. We will solve this conflict of interest.”

12.speaker: Player
12.text: “That's enough. Calm down, both of you.”

13.speaker: Lileas Graf
13.text: “This issue has been in the back of my head for a long time and now it caused real damage.”

14.speaker: Lileas Graf
14.text: “I am trying *really* hard to stay calm, Mr. President.”

15.speaker: Iosef Lancea
15.text: “Ms. Graf, you are pushing your boundaries.”

16.speaker: Narrator
16.text: It was not hard to guess what this meeting was going to be about.

17.speaker: Narrator
17.text: We entered the city hall and made our way to the second floor. I could hear Iosef and Lileas's voices echoing through the hall.

18.speaker: Narrator
18.text: I arrived in the city of Vesord with my new Vice President, Albin, after receiving an emergency meeting request from Iosef and Lileas.

19.speaker: Iosef Lancea
19.text: “Apologies, but Ms. Graf here fails to understand her place.”

20.speaker: Lileas Graf
20.text: “No, Mr. Lancea. You are the one who does not understand his place.”

21.speaker: Lileas Graf
21.text: “If you continue to do so, you will pay for it one day.”

22.speaker: Iosef Lancea
22.text: “Indeed, it has. All because of the *exemplary* behaviour of your police.”

24.speaker: Player
24.text: “Iosef. Let's hear your side of the story.”

25.speaker: Iosef Lancea
25.text: “The Lieutenant-General of the Gendarmerie was tracking a drug trafficking ring in the countryside of Vesord.”

27.speaker: Lileas Graf
27.text: “Mr. Greiser was tasked with the investigation of a drug trafficking ring in downtown Vesord.”

28.speaker: Lileas Graf
28.text: “We found the evidence of a drug stash located in the outskirts of the city.”

29.speaker: Lileas Graf
29.text: “So we immediately sent our police units to catch them and find the drugs in the compound.”

30.speaker: Lileas Graf
30.text: “We had to act quickly to put an end to the criminals we have been watching for some time.”

31.speaker: Lileas Graf
31.text: “Mr. Lancea and his Gendarmerie did not notify us that they were also moving against the same target.”

32.speaker: Lileas Graf
32.text: “As a result, criminals got away and we lost months of progress!”

33.speaker: Player
33.text: “So, the police meddled and caused the raid to fail.”

35.speaker: Iosef Lancea
35.text: “Now these criminals are free because of it.”

36.speaker: Player
36.text: “Isn't there a line of communication between you?”

37.speaker: Iosef Lancea
37.text: “The same could be said about you because the reports show that you knew about the gang and their stash in the countryside.”

38.speaker: Lileas Graf
38.text: “There is, but the Minister of Defense decided to avoid notifying the police department about the planned raid.”

39.speaker: Player
39.text: “So, the Gendarmerie meddled and caused the raid to fail.”

41.speaker: Lileas Graf
41.text: “Now these criminals are free because of it.”

42.speaker: Iosef Lancea
42.text: “You must have known how dangerous they were and the fact that they carried weapons.”

43.speaker: Player
43.text: “You went out of your jurisdiction to pursue these criminals.”

44.speaker: Lileas Graf
44.text: “I did nothing of that sort. We followed a gang that was active in the city and the investigation was completely related to that.”

45.speaker: Iosef Lancea
45.text: “You should've let us handle it. Gendarmerie is better trained for combat situations.”

47.speaker: Iosef Lancea
47.text: “Just when we were about to raid their hideout with live weapons, the police units arrived in the scene and alerted the criminals.”

48.speaker: Player
48.text: “Didn't you rush the situation a little there, Iosef?”

49.speaker: Iosef Lancea
49.text: “Sir, we received reports that they were heavily armed. We acted to ensure no harm could come to civilians.”

50.speaker: Lileas Graf
50.text: “You acted too swiftly and without notifying us.”

51.speaker: Iosef Lancea
51.text: “Big words after you allowed them to escape.”

52.speaker: Lileas Graf
52.text: “Big words after you allowed them to escape.”

53.speaker: Iosef Lancea
53.text: “You must have known how dangerous they were and the fact that they carried weapons.”

54.speaker: Iosef Lancea
54.text: “You should've let us handle it. Gendarmerie is better trained for combat situations.”

55.speaker: Narrator
55.text: I started tapping on the table with my fingers.

56.speaker: Player
56.text: “What I hear is that you are both incompetent.”

57.speaker: Player
57.text: “How do we solve this issue so that it never happens again?”

58.speaker: Player
58.text: “We are getting nowhere. We need to find a middle ground.”

60.speaker: Narrator
60.text: Both of them started staring at the table without saying anything.

62.speaker: Lileas Graf
62.text: “I think this was the last drop.”

63.speaker: Lileas Graf
63.text: “Internal security matters should be handed to Ministry of Interior completely.”

64.speaker: Lileas Graf
64.text: “We are called the Ministry of *Interior* for a reason. We can't let any more screw ups like this happen again.”

65.speaker: Lileas Graf
65.text: “I want the Gendarmerie to be transferred to the Ministry of Interior.”

67.speaker: Narrator
67.text: Iosef turned red with anger. He composed himself after a moment.

68.speaker: Iosef Lancea
68.text: “Ridiculous! This is absolutely ridiculous. I won't hand over Gendarmerie to her. Out of the question.”

74.speaker: Iosef Lancea
74.text: “Besides assisting our internal security, in a time of war the Gendarmerie is a strong asset to defend our country.”

75.speaker: Lileas Graf
75.text: “The police forces have certain units that are capable of conducting similar operations.”

76.speaker: Iosef Lancea
76.text: “Because the Gendarmerie is also part of the military structure and must be tied to the Defense.”

77.speaker: Lileas Graf
77.text: “We could work on establishing that but it still doesn't change the wrong system that exists now.”

78.speaker: Player
78.text: “I agree. The Gendarmerie has been a part of the Ministry of Defense for years.”

79.speaker: Iosef Lancea
79.text: “You already reduced the military budget and dealt a blow to our defense.”

80.speaker: Player
80.text: “Do you have a better solution, Iosef?”

81.speaker: Iosef Lancea
81.text: “The police forces don't have the right equipment and reach to cover rural areas like the Gendarmerie does.”

82.speaker: Iosef Lancea
82.text: “Whenever operations overlap, we should engage at a lower rank with the local officers on both sides.”

83.speaker: Iosef Lancea
83.text: “I can't understand why you are continuing to weaken our military.”

84.speaker: Player
84.text: “I remember it very well. Don't you worry.”

89.speaker: Player
89.text: “Yes, but my decision hasn't been made yet.”

90.speaker: Lileas Graf
90.text: “No matter what we need to eliminate this grey area and modernise our internal security.”

91.speaker: Lileas Graf
91.text: “I want to remind you about your promise, Mr. President.”

92.speaker: Player
92.text: “What promise? I don't remember any promises I made.”

94.speaker: Lileas Graf
94.text: “I sure hope that you will keep your word.”

95.speaker: Lileas Graf
95.text: “I see. I was a fool to trust that you would keep your word.”

96.speaker: Lileas Graf
96.text: “That is not how promises work, Mr. President.”

97.speaker: Iosef Lancea
97.text: “Now I see what is going on here.”

100.speaker: Iosef Lancea
100.text: “Lileas set us up to create this incident.”

102.speaker: Player
102.text: “Enlighthen us. What is going on here, Iosef?”

103.speaker: Iosef Lancea
103.text: “Now I see what is going on here.”

105.speaker: Iosef Lancea
105.text: “There is no way that the police has arrived at the right time of a month long search on the exact day and minute of the Gendarmerie raid.”

108.speaker: Player
108.text: “Let us take it down a notch with the accusations.”

109.speaker: Lileas Graf
109.text: “It is very disappointing that you would even entertain the idea.”

110.speaker: Lileas Graf
110.text: “It very much is a conspiracy theory.”

111.speaker: Lileas Graf
111.text: “This kind of an accusation is unheard of.”

112.speaker: Iosef Lancea
112.conditionsRaw:
(Variable["BaseGame.Reform_PresiPower_Strong_PurgeGeneralStaff"] == false  and

114.speaker: Lileas Graf
114.text: “If I were you, I wouldn't believe a word Mr. Lancea says, Mr. President.”

115.speaker: Iosef Lancea
115.text: “When dealing with these situations, you need to always look at who gets what out of it.”

116.speaker: Lileas Graf
116.text: “I won't stand idle by these utterly ridiculous and baseless accusations. I don't have time for this.”

119.speaker: Player
119.text: “From now on work together and don't fight among each other. I want capable and effective members of cabinet.”

121.speaker: Iosef Lancea
121.text: “Thank you for protecting the structure and authority of the Ministry of Defense.”

122.speaker: Player
122.text: “There will be no change related to the Gendarmerie operations.”

123.speaker: Lileas Graf
123.text: “It was the right call to establish a modern internal security structure.”
123.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Lileas_GendermariePromise"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Turn03_EnT_Military_Budget_Maintain"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn03_EnT_Military_Budget_Maintain"] == true) == false)

124.speaker: Player
124.text: “There are bigger issues at hand that need attention. Focus on them instead of each other.”

125.speaker: Player
125.text: “I want those criminals to be caught immediately.”

126.speaker: Lileas Graf
126.text: “We have interrogated the ones caught and are after the others who have escaped.”

127.speaker: Lileas Graf
127.text: “We will do our best. Right, Mr. Lancea?”

131.speaker: Iosef Lancea
131.text: “Don't worry. They will get the justice they deserve.”

133.speaker: Narrator
133.text: I left the room to attend to my next scheduled meeting.

134.speaker: Player
134.text: “The Gendarmerie will be transferred to the Ministry of Interior.”

135.speaker: Narrator
135.text: The report said that an operation against a drug trafficking gang in Vesord failed due to miscommunication.

136.speaker: Iosef Lancea
136.text: “Woman, are you out of your mind?”

176.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn08_VPSelection_Lucian"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn08_VPSelection_Albin"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn08_VPSelection_Gloria"] == true) == false)

182.speaker: Albin Clavin
182.text: “We need to find out what is causing this and fix it.”

183.speaker: Gloria Tory
183.text: “If we unify the command, our internal security will improve. There is no question to that.”

185.speaker: Lucian Galade
185.text: “We would reap the benefits in the long run.”

186.speaker: Iosef Lancea
186.text: “Look, Ms. Tory. I know you are new at this and there is much that you were not briefed about but-”

187.speaker: Gloria Tory
187.text: “I don't have to be briefed to see common sense, Mr. Lancea.”
